# REDTEAM #63 (SPEC Sec 3.1, T-301.1): panic leaking arena watermarks on
# unwind. Frame exit, including exit by panic, MUST restore the watermark,
# and the restore MUST run as an emitted defer during unwinding. The attack
# allocates arena memory and then panics; a missing unwind restore leaks
# the watermark so NoscanUsed stays elevated after the panic is recovered.
# The direct unit proof is TestLogosArenaPanicUnwindRecovery in
# src/runtime/logos_arena_test.go: it records NoscanUsed, runs an
# arena-allocating call that panics under a recovering closure, and fails
# when the post-recovery watermark differs from the baseline. A value-only
# check passes despite the leak, so this script runs the watermark-count
# gate that fails on count, not values.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOEXPERIMENT=logosarena
go test -count=1 -run 'TestLogosArenaPanicUnwindRecovery' runtime
go test -race -count=1 -run 'TestLogosArenaPanicUnwindRecovery' runtime

-- go.mod --
module example.com/redteam63

go 1.27
